protocol.selection: user-selected single baseline cell; first canonical baseline, no listed source issues
protocol.capacity: fixed to measured complete RPT discharge Ah
protocol.rpt_constraint: measured current-interruption voltage response at 20% and 60% DOD
protocol.ocv_correction: 0.6A steady low-rate IR correction plus fitted 4*SOC*(1-SOC) interior correction; endpoints unshifted
protocol.acceptance_basis: predeclared engineering response criteria; no hardware or detectability guarantee

excluded.reason: fewer than twelve complete post-RPT missions

limitations: One user-selected baseline cell only; temporal holdout is not independent-cell validation
RPT capacity defines accessible charge; no SOH or RUL estimator
Low-rate voltage is an OCV proxy; one RC cannot uniquely separate every electrochemical mechanism
Pulse and mission parameters are effective approximations; SOC and temperature dependence unresolved
Identical balanced cell-to-pack scaling, fixed interconnect and lumped thermal assumptions
Prescribed linear stage transitions are fault injections, not measured aging kinetics
No real X500 hardware or assembled-pack validation
